notes: Distances and durations are realistic estimates for family travel in SEQ; driving estimates include fuel + tolls but exclude parking.
Public-transport modes use perPerson:true and kidDiscount:0.5 (children roughly half adult fare on coaches/shuttles).

Translink currently runs a 50c flat fare across SEQ, but long-distance coach/shuttle operators (Greyhound, Con-X-ion, private shuttles) still charge per-person market rates — those are reflected here.
Train options only listed where a direct or single-transfer rail service exists (e.g. Gold Coast and Sunshine Coast lines to/from Brisbane).
Bus options cover coach/long-distance buses and regional Translink coach connections where realistic.
Shuttle options cover private airport/hotel shuttle services, commonly used by families.
Omitted: modes that do not realistically exist for a pair (e.g. direct train Gold Coast ↔ Noosa, direct train Sunshine Coast ↔ Noosa beyond bus feeders).
